title: GAIA Agent Hub Catalog Index
description: Lightweight catalog served at GET /index.json. One entry per published package, summarising its latest version. Every lane -- agents, apps, components (#1716) and skills (#2467) -- lives in the one `agents` array and is discriminated by `type`; the key keeps its historical name so existing consumers parse the catalog unchanged. Agent-lane field names mirror gaia-agent.yaml (docs/spec/agent-hub-restructure.mdx); skill-lane fields mirror SKILL.md (docs/plans/skill-format.mdx). This is the contract the website Hub pages build from (website/src/data/catalog.ts).

schema_version.description: Index schema version; bumped on breaking shape changes.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last index rebuild.

agents.description: Every catalog entry, all lanes. Filter on `type` to segment agents from apps/components/skills.

id.description: Package slug used in hub URLs (/hub/<id>). One namespace across every lane: an agent id and a skill name can never collide.

category.description: Display category. Skill entries always use "skills".

type.description: Catalog lane (#1716, #2467). Absent on entries published before the discriminator existed, which are agents. A consumer that renders every entry as an installable agent MUST filter on this.

latest_version.description: Highest published SemVer for this package.

language.description: Implementation language. Skills report "python" when they declare metadata.gaia.tools (they ship a tools.py) and "markdown" when they are instruction-only.

download_size_bytes.description: Size of the latest version's artifact in bytes.

tools_count.description: Number of tools the agent registers; 0 when the manifest omits it.

min_gaia_version.description: Minimum GAIA version (SemVer); empty string when the manifest omits it.

permissions.description: Declared permission strings; empty array when the manifest omits them.

deprecation_message.description: Only present when the latest version's manifest declares one.

npu.description: "required" when the manifest sets requirements.npu: true, else "optional".

readme.description: The entry's primary doc markdown for the latest version; empty string if none was published. README.md for agents/apps/components; for a skill entry this is the SKILL.md BODY (front matter stripped), which is that package's primary doc.

changelog.description: CHANGELOG.md markdown of the latest version; empty string if none was published.

spec.description: SPEC.md (technical reference) markdown of the latest version; empty string if none was published.

skill.description: SKILL.md (AI-integration playbook) markdown of the latest version; empty string if none was published.

evaluation.description: EVALUATION.md (evaluation guide) markdown of the latest version; empty string if none was published.

capability_matrix.description: CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md markdown of the latest version; empty string if none was published.

scorecard.description: Eval-scorecard markdown (SCORECARD.md body, YAML front matter stripped) of the latest version, rendered as its own doc tab; empty string if none was published.

eval_scorecard_url.description: Public URL of the eval scorecard markdown for the latest version; absent when none was published.

eval_score.description: Aggregate eval score (0-100) parsed from the latest version's scorecard front matter; absent when none was published or parseable.

npm_package.description: npm package name when the agent is distributed via npm (e.g. "@amd-gaia/agent-email"); absent otherwise.

playground_url.description: Localhost playground URL served by the agent's sidecar; absent otherwise.

skill_metadata.description: Skill-lane fields from SKILL.md's metadata.gaia namespace (#2467). Present ONLY on type: "skill" entries. security_tier and permissions are not repeated here -- they are top-level and mean the same thing in both lanes.

tools_required.description: Names of existing registry tools the skill CONSUMES (the recipe contract, #887/#1451). Never conflate with `tools`.

requirements.description: metadata.gaia.requirements. Unrelated to the agent-lane `requirements` block; unset fields are emitted as "" / [] so the shape is stable.

audit.description: Pre-publish security-audit result (#2468) recorded at publish time. BLOCK and REVIEW verdicts are rejected at publish and never reach the catalog, so only ALLOW (a report cleared the gate) and "unaudited" (advisory tier, no report supplied) appear here.

engine.description: Audit engine id + version that produced the verdict; empty string when unaudited.

audited_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the audit; empty string when unaudited.

findings.description: Number of non-blocking findings the audit surfaced.

package.description: Whole-package download (all platform binaries + client + docs) as a single zip plus its file listing. Present only when a package_files manifest was published for the latest version.

filename.description: Zip artifact filename under the version dir, e.g. "agent-email-0.2.1.zip".
